title: Backend Engineer, Evidence Platform
summary: Build and operate backend services that ingest documents, coordinate asynchronous processing, preserve evidence provenance and expose reliable APIs to reviewers.
responsibilities: Own a production Python service from design through on-call operations.
Design idempotent asynchronous workflows with retries and recovery.
Build observable APIs and workers with measurable reliability targets.
Improve latency, correctness or operational efficiency using evidence.

requirements.label: Owns a production backend service
requirements.evidence_expectation: Specific service, ownership boundary, real users or traffic, and operational responsibility.

requirements.label: Designs reliable asynchronous workflows
requirements.evidence_expectation: Concrete retries, idempotency, queues, recovery or event-processing implementation.

requirements.label: Operates observable and reliable systems
requirements.evidence_expectation: Monitoring, SLO, alerting, incident response or production debugging ownership.

requirements.label: Improves measurable system outcomes
requirements.evidence_expectation: Before-and-after metric connected to the candidate's action.
